subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR)
purpose: Per-topic target quotas for building a question BANK/dataset, not a simulation of a single session's paper. Multiply/scale as needed. Because DILR questions come bundled in sets (not standalone), quotas here are per-question targets intended to be assembled into sets of 4-6 sharing one caselet, not generated as isolated questions.
question_type_note: CAT DILR mixes single-correct MCQ and TITA within the same set; roughly 55-65% MCQ / 35-45% TITA overall. There is no separate 'easy tier' the way school exams have one - DILR difficulty is driven mainly by the caselet's constraint complexity rather than by any single question in isolation.
difficulty_note: Puzzles/Arrangements and Games & Tournaments skew hardest since they depend on fully cracking a multi-constraint caselet before any question in the set can be answered confidently.
